source.original_text:
Let E be any finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel space, including dimension zero. Let V:E→ℝ be C², α,β≥0 and η∈ℝ with α>0, α≤β, α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v∈E, η>0 and βη≤1. The following literal constructions are made for all y,r∈E and initial phases z₀∈E×E; the existential process witness below is global in these parameters. Put c=y−η∇V(r), Φ_t(x,p)=(c+cos(t)(x−c)+√η sin(t)p, −sin(t)(x−c)/√η+cos(t)p), g_r(x)=∇V(x)−∇V(r), S_r(x,p)=(x,p−2〈p,g_r(x)〉g_r(x)/‖g_r(x)‖²), λ_r(x,p)=√η max{0,〈p,g_r(x)〉}, Λ_z(t)=∫₀ᵗλ_r(Φ_s(z))ds and τ_z(e)=inf{t≥0:Λ_z(t)≥e}∈[0,∞], with inf empty=∞. Total real division makes S_r the identity at g_r(x)=0. The record space is D=([0,∞)×(E×E))⊕{stopped}, with Borel sum structure. Define next(e,stopped)=stopped; for a live record (T,z), next(e,(T,z))=stopped if τ_z(e)=∞, and otherwise next(e,(T,z))=(T+τ_z(e),S_rΦ_(τ_z(e))(z)). In the Lean definition untopD0 is used only in this non-top branch. Define R₀(e)=live(0,z₀) and R_(j+1)(e)=next(e_j,R_j(e)). Let Ω=ℝ^ℕ with its product Borel structure and P=⊗_(k≥0)Exp(1). Let ε(w)_k=max{w_k,0}; this is an ambient coordinate extension on a P-null nonpositive-clock set, not new source dynamics for negative clocks. 
Write T_j(w)=a for a live record R_j(ε(w))=live(a,z), and T_j(w)=∞ for a stopped record. Define I_n(T)={T_n≤T<T_(n+1)}, and the total selector N(T,w)=min{n:w∈I_n(T)} when such an n exists, and 0 otherwise. For n≥0 let Hist_n=D^(Fin(n+1)) and H_n(w)_j=R_j(ε(w)). Write readTime(live(a,z))=a and readTime(stopped)=0. The abstract guard A_n(T) consists of histories all of whose records are live, whose read times are strictly increasing and whose positive-index read times are strictly below T; it does not constrain record0 itself. Actual H_n starts at live(0,z₀). For h∈Hist_n set d_n(T,h)=max{T−readTime(h_n),0}. Define survival(live(a,z),u,e) to mean u<τ_z(max{e,0}); on stopped it is false. Define W(live(a,z),u)=exp(−Λ_z(u)); on stopped W=0. Put C_n(T)={w:H_n(w)∈A_n(T), survival(R_n(ε(w)),d_n(T,H_n(w)),w_n)}.
For a fixed finite T≥0 let Path_T be all functions from [0,T] into E×E, with its coordinate-product sigma algebra. On every history, including unrealizable ones, define Ψ_n(T,h)(s) by starting at z₀ and visiting j=0,…,n in increasing order: a live record (a,z) with a≤s replaces the current value by Φ_(s−a)(z), and an ineligible live or stopped record leaves it unchanged. All elapsed times in this total definition use nonnegative subtraction.
Define Δ_n(T)={t∈ℝ^n:0<t₁<⋯<t_n<T}, and let m_n be the comap of product Lebesgue measure to this subtype, without normalization. For t∈Δ_n(T), put s₀=0,s_i=t_i, z₀ equal to the prescribed initial phase and z_i=S_rΦ_(s_i−s_(i−1))(z_(i−1)). Set K_n(t)_j=live(s_j,z_j), Γ_n(T,t)=Ψ_n(T,K_n(t)), q_n(t)=ofReal(∏_(i=1)^n λ_r(Φ_(s_i−s_(i−1))(z_(i−1)))exp[−Λ_(z_(i−1))(s_i−s_(i−1))]), and ρ_n(T,t)=q_n(t)W(K_n(t)_n,d_n(T,K_n(t))). The literal toNNReal conversions agree with these nonnegative simplex times.
There exists one actual phase representative Z(y,r,z₀,t,w), jointly Borel in all deterministic parameters, finite time and raw input, with the following properties. On every raw covering interval T_n(w)≤s<T_(n+1)(w), if R_n(ε(w))=live(a,z), then Z(s,w)=Φ_(s−a)(z). If no interval covers s, Z(s,w)=z₀. For each fixed parameter tuple, Z(0,w)=z₀ almost surely.

Put R(x,p)=(x,-p), V_y(x)=V(x)+||x-y||^2/(2 eta), and nu_y=(volume_E.tilted(-V_y)) times stdGaussian(E), in position/momentum order. Here tilted(-V_y) has density ofReal(exp(-V_y(x))/integral exp(-V_y) dx), and stdGaussian is the centered identity-covariance Gaussian. Normalizability is a consequence, not a premise.

Write H=E times E, pi_y=volume_E.tilted(-V_y), gamma=stdGaussian(E), so nu_y=pi_y times gamma. For the same single global actual Z described above, every y,r in E and every finite T>=0, define op_T G(z)=integral G(Z(y,r,z,T,w)) dP(w), a real Bochner integral, and endpoint_T(z,w)=Z(y,r,z,T,w). Then endpoint_T is measurable and its pushforward of nu_y times P is exactly nu_y.
For every pair F,G:H->R of Borel measurable functions and finite real bounds C_F,C_G>=0 with |F(z)|<=C_F and |G(z)|<=C_G for all z, both z->F(z)*op_T G(z) and z->G(R(z))*op_T(F composed R)(z) are integrable against nu_y, and their real integrals are equal. Thus integral F(z)*op_T G(z) dnu_y(z) = integral G(R(z))*op_T(F composed R)(z) dnu_y(z).
All these conclusions use the same Z, existentially chosen before all centers, references, horizons and observables. Products are phase first, clock input second. No process, kernel, finite mass, signed integrability, momentum symmetry or normalizability is a supplied premise. Dimension zero, T=0, vanishing test bounds, zero bounce rates, infinite waits and raw exceptional fallback remain included. Almost-sure initialization stays parameterwise; no uniform all-parameter null set or pointwise reversed path at jumps is asserted.

For every Borel G:H->R, the total real clock expectation (y,r,z,T)->integral G(Z(y,r,z,T,w)) dP(w) is jointly Borel. If C is a finite nonnegative real number and |G(z)|<=C for all z, then for every y,r,z,T the clock section is P-integrable and the absolute value of this expectation is at most C.
For every y,r in E there exists a family A indexed by finite nonnegative T, where A_T:L2(nu_y;R)->L2(nu_y;R) is a continuous real linear operator, A_0 is the identity and ||A_T||<=1 for every T. For every real function G with MemLp G 2 nu_y (almost-everywhere strong measurability and finite L2 seminorm), the section w->G(Z(y,r,z,T,w)) is P-integrable for nu_y-almost every z. The literal expectation op_T G belongs to L2(nu_y;R), and A_T[G]=[op_T G]. Thus integral |op_T G|^2 dnu_y <= integral |G|^2 dnu_y. Brackets denote equality classes modulo nu_y-almost-everywhere equality; no pointwise identification of arbitrary L2 representatives is asserted. The operator, section integrability and output L2 membership are conclusions, not supplied premises.
These operators use the same single global Z as all inherited path, initialization, invariance and bounded-duality conclusions. The bound1 is exact and independent of dimension, center, reference and horizon. The joint Borel assertion concerns Borel input G; arbitrary MemLp representatives receive the stated almost-everywhere conclusions. There is no joint measurability or continuity claim for the operator-valued family, no strong-continuity claim, and no assertion of full L2 momentum-flip duality Eq A.3, restart/Markov/semigroup, equality with a separately existential kernel, hypocoercivity, implementation accuracy or actual expected costs. Full papers and actual-input composition remain open.

{E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {V : E → ℝ} {α β : ℝ≥0} {η : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < (α : ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E,
      (α : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ (β : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β : ℝ) * η ≤ 1) :
    let c : E → E → E := fun y xRef => y - η • gradient V xRef
    let Φ : E → E → ℝ → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun y xRef t z =>
      (c y xRef + Real.cos t • (z.1 - c y xRef) +
          (Real.sqrt η * Real.sin t) • z.2,
       (-Real.sin t / Real.sqrt η) • (z.1 - c y xRef) + Real.cos t • z.2)
    let S : E → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun xRef z =>
      (z.1, z.2 - (2 * inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef) /
        ‖gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef‖ ^ 2) • (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
    let rate : E → (E × E) → ℝ := fun xRef z =>
      Real.sqrt η * max 0 (inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
    let Λ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → ℝ := fun y xRef z t =>
      ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(t : ℝ), rate xRef (Φ y xRef s z)
    let τ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → WithTop ℝ≥0 := fun y xRef z e =>
      MeasureTheory.hittingAfter
        (fun t : ℝ≥0 => fun a : (E × E) × (E × E) × ℝ≥0 =>
          Λ a.1.1 a.1.2 a.2.1 t - (a.2.2 : ℝ))
        (Set.Ici (0 : ℝ)) 0 ((y, xRef), z, e)
    let next : E → E → ℝ≥0 → ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) →
        ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) := fun y xRef e r =>
      match r with
      | Sum.inr _ => Sum.inr ()
      | Sum.inl a =>
        if τ y xRef a.2 e = ⊤ then Sum.inr () else
          Sum.inl (a.1 + (τ y xRef a.2 e).untopD 0,
            S xRef (Φ y xRef (((τ y xRef a.2 e).untopD 0 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) a.2))
    let record : E → E → (E × E) → (ℕ → ℝ≥0) → ℕ →
        ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) := fun y xRef z₀ e n =>
      Nat.rec (Sum.inl (0, z₀)) (fun k r => next y xRef (e k) r) n
    let P : Measure (ℕ → ℝ) := Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => expMeasure (1 : ℝ))
    let ε : (ℕ → ℝ) → ℕ → ℝ≥0 := fun w k => Real.toNNReal (w k)
    let history : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (ℕ → ℝ) →
        (Fin (n + 1) → ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit)) :=
      fun y xRef z₀ n w j => record y xRef z₀ (ε w) j.val
    let Rec := (ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit
    let Hist : ℕ → Type _ := fun n => Fin (n + 1) → Rec
    let readTime : Rec → ℝ := fun r => match r with
      | Sum.inl q => (q.1 : ℝ)
      | Sum.inr _ => 0
    let Δ : (n : ℕ) → ℝ≥0 → Set (Fin n → ℝ) := fun n T =>
      {t | StrictMono (Fin.cons (0 : ℝ) t) ∧ ∀ i, t i < (T : ℝ)}
    let Prefix : (n : ℕ) → ℝ≥0 → Type := fun n T => {t : Fin n → ℝ // t ∈ Δ n T}
    let m : (n : ℕ) → (T : ℝ≥0) → Measure (Prefix n T) := fun n T =>
      Measure.comap (fun t : Prefix n T => t.val) (volume : Measure (Fin n → ℝ))
    let zAt : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (T : ℝ≥0) →
        Prefix n T → Fin (n + 1) → (E × E) := fun y xRef z₀ n T t =>
      Fin.induction z₀ (fun i z =>
        S xRef (Φ y xRef (t.val i - (Fin.cons (0 : ℝ) (t.val : Fin n → ℝ) : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) i.castSucc) z))
    let K : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (T : ℝ≥0) →
        Prefix n T → Hist n := fun y xRef z₀ n T t j =>
      Sum.inl (Real.toNNReal ((Fin.cons (0 : ℝ) (t.val : Fin n → ℝ) : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) j), zAt y xRef z₀ n T t j)
    let qReal : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (T : ℝ≥0) →
        Prefix n T → ℝ := fun y xRef z₀ n T t =>
      ∏ i : Fin n,
        rate xRef (Φ y xRef (t.val i - (Fin.cons (0 : ℝ) (t.val : Fin n → ℝ) : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) i.castSucc)
          (zAt y xRef z₀ n T t i.castSucc)) *
        Real.exp (-Λ y xRef (zAt y xRef z₀ n T t i.castSucc)
          (Real.toNNReal (t.val i - (Fin.cons (0 : ℝ) (t.val : Fin n → ℝ) : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) i.castSucc)))
    let q : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (T : ℝ≥0) →
        Prefix n T → ℝ≥0∞ := fun y xRef z₀ n T t =>
      ENNReal.ofReal (qReal y xRef z₀ n T t)
    let A : (n : ℕ) → ℝ≥0 → Set (Hist n) := fun n T =>
      {h | (∀ j, ∃ a : ℝ≥0 × (E × E), h j = Sum.inl a) ∧
        StrictMono (fun j => readTime (h j)) ∧
        ∀ i : Fin n, readTime (h i.succ) < (T : ℝ)}
    let eventTime : E → E → (E × E) → (ℕ → ℝ) → ℕ → WithTop ℝ≥0 :=
      fun y xRef z₀ w j => (record y xRef z₀ (ε w) j).elim
        (fun a => (a.1 : WithTop ℝ≥0)) (fun _ => ⊤)
    let I : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → ℕ → Set (ℕ → ℝ) :=
      fun y xRef z₀ T n => {w | eventTime y xRef z₀ w n ≤ (T : WithTop ℝ≥0) ∧
        (T : WithTop ℝ≥0) < eventTime y xRef z₀ w (n + 1)}
    let N : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → (ℕ → ℝ) → ℕ := fun y xRef z₀ T w =>
      if h : ∃ n, w ∈ I y xRef z₀ T n then Nat.find h else 0
    let liveTime : Rec → ℝ≥0 := fun r => r.elim Prod.fst (fun _ => 0)
    let d : (n : ℕ) → ℝ≥0 → Hist n → ℝ≥0 :=
      fun n T h => T - liveTime (h ⟨n, Nat.lt_succ_self n⟩)
    let survival : E → E → Rec → ℝ≥0 → ℝ → Prop :=
      fun y xRef r u e => r.elim
        (fun a => (u : WithTop ℝ≥0) < τ y xRef a.2 (Real.toNNReal e)) (fun _ => False)
    let weight : E → E → Rec → ℝ≥0 → ℝ≥0∞ :=
      fun y xRef r u => r.elim
        (fun a => ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-Λ y xRef a.2 u))) (fun _ => 0)
    let C : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → ℝ≥0 → Set (ℕ → ℝ) :=
      fun y xRef z₀ n T => {w | history y xRef z₀ n w ∈ A n T ∧
        survival y xRef (record y xRef z₀ (ε w) n) (d n T (history y xRef z₀ n w)) (w n)}
    let Path : ℝ≥0 → Type _ := fun T => {s : ℝ≥0 // s ≤ T} → E × E
    let Ψ : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (T : ℝ≥0) → Hist n → Path T :=
      fun y xRef z₀ n T h s =>
        Fin.foldl (n + 1) (fun z j => (h j).elim
          (fun a => if a.1 ≤ s.val then Φ y xRef ((s.val - a.1 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) a.2 else z)
          (fun _ => z)) z₀
    let Γ : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (T : ℝ≥0) → Prefix n T → Path T :=
      fun y xRef z₀ n T t => Ψ y xRef z₀ n T (K y xRef z₀ n T t)
    let ρ : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (T : ℝ≥0) → Prefix n T → ℝ≥0∞ :=
      fun y xRef z₀ n T t => q y xRef z₀ n T t *
        weight y xRef ((K y xRef z₀ n T t) ⟨n, Nat.lt_succ_self n⟩)
          (d n T (K y xRef z₀ n T t))
    let R : E × E → E × E := fun z => (z.1, -z.2)
    let Vy : E → E → ℝ := fun y x => V x + ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 / (2 * η)
    let nu : E → Measure (E × E) := fun y =>
      ((volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -Vy y x)).prod
        (ProbabilityTheory.stdGaussian E)
    ∃ Z : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → (ℕ → ℝ) → (E × E),
      Measurable (fun a : ((E × E) × (E × E)) × ℝ≥0 × (ℕ → ℝ) =>
        Z a.1.1.1 a.1.1.2 a.1.2 a.2.1 a.2.2) ∧
      (∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E, ∀ w : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ s : ℝ≥0,
        ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ a : ℝ≥0 × (E × E), w ∈ I y xRef z₀ s n →
          record y xRef z₀ (ε w) n = Sum.inl a →
          Z y xRef z₀ s w = Φ y xRef ((s - a.1 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) a.2) ∧
      (∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E, ∀ w : ℕ → ℝ, ∀ s : ℝ≥0,
        (¬ ∃ n, w ∈ I y xRef z₀ s n) → Z y xRef z₀ s w = z₀) ∧
      (∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E, ∀ᵐ w ∂P, Z y xRef z₀ 0 w = z₀) ∧
      (∀ y xRef : E, ∀ T : ℝ≥0,
        let op : ((E × E) → ℝ) → (E × E) → ℝ :=
          fun G z => ∫ w, G (Z y xRef z T w) ∂P
        let endpoint : (E × E) × (ℕ → ℝ) → E × E :=
          fun a => Z y xRef a.1 T a.2
        MeasurePreserving endpoint ((nu y).prod P) (nu y) ∧
        ∀ F G : (E × E) → ℝ, ∀ C_F C_G : ℝ,
          Measurable F → Measurable G → 0 ≤ C_F → 0 ≤ C_G →
          (∀ z, |F z| ≤ C_F) → (∀ z, |G z| ≤ C_G) →
          Integrable (fun z => F z * op G z) (nu y) ∧
          Integrable (fun z => G (R z) * op (fun a => F (R a)) z) (nu y) ∧
          (∫ z, F z * op G z ∂nu y) =
            ∫ z, G (R z) * op (fun a => F (R a)) z ∂nu y) ∧
      (∀ G : (E × E) → ℝ, Measurable G →
        Measurable (fun a : ((E × E) × (E × E)) × ℝ≥0 =>
          ∫ w, G (Z a.1.1.1 a.1.1.2 a.1.2 a.2 w) ∂P) ∧
        ∀ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C → (∀ z, |G z| ≤ C) →
          ∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z : E × E, ∀ T : ℝ≥0,
            Integrable (fun w => G (Z y xRef z T w)) P ∧
            |∫ w, G (Z y xRef z T w) ∂P| ≤ C) ∧
      (∀ y xRef : E,
        ∃ A : ℝ≥0 → (Lp ℝ 2 (nu y) →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 (nu y)),
          A 0 = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Lp ℝ 2 (nu y)) ∧
          ∀ T : ℝ≥0, ‖A T‖ ≤ 1 ∧
            ∀ G : (E × E) → ℝ, ∀ hG : MemLp G 2 (nu y),
              let opG : (E × E) → ℝ := fun z => ∫ w, G (Z y xRef z T w) ∂P
              (∀ᵐ z ∂nu y, Integrable (fun w => G (Z y xRef z T w)) P) ∧
              (∃ hOp : MemLp opG 2 (nu y), A T (hG.toLp G) = hOp.toLp opG) ∧
              (∫ z, |opG z| ^ 2 ∂nu y) ≤ ∫ z, |G z| ^ 2 ∂nu y)
decoder_context: Finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel space with canonical volume, including rank zero; genuine second Frechet derivative and real Hilbert gradient.
Fin n is zero-based; Fin.cons prepends; Fin.induction constructs a finite sequence; Fin.foldl visits ascending indices. Sum.inl represents a live time/state record; Unit represents a stopped record.

Real division by zero is zero; Real.toNNReal is positive part; nonnegative subtraction is truncated. ENNReal.ofReal embeds the positive part in extended nonnegative reals. Interval integrals use real Lebesgue measure.

Measure.tilted mu h is mu.withDensity(x -> ofReal(exp(h(x))/integral exp(h) dmu)). stdGaussian E is the centered identity-covariance Gaussian. Measure.comap along a measurable subtype inclusion is the induced subtype measure. Products use the displayed coordinate order.

MeasurePreserving f mu nu states Measurable f and Measure.map f mu = nu. withDensity multiplies the base measure by the given extended-nonnegative density. Measure.sum is the countable sum of the displayed measures. IsProbabilityMeasure means total mass one. All literal let bindings are definitions, not hypotheses.

hittingAfter f D 0 a is the infimum of nonnegative times t at which f t a lies in D, in WithTop nonnegative reals; the empty infimum is top. untopD 0 returns the finite value when not top and zero otherwise.

Measure.infinitePi constructs the displayed countable product law; expMeasure 1 is the unit-rate exponential probability measure on real numbers. The function space carries the coordinate-product measurable structure. A measurable global process and its almost-everywhere initialization are conclusions.

Lp R 2 mu is the real Hilbert space of square-integrable strongly measurable functions modulo almost-everywhere equality; MemLp is the corresponding property of a raw function and hG.toLp G is its equivalence class.
The notation X ->L[R] Y means a continuous real linear map with operator norm. ContinuousLinearMap.id is the identity; an indexed family of such maps alone imposes no continuity in the index.

def actual_l2_expectation_statement{E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {V : E → ℝ} {α β : ℝ≥0} {η : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < (α : ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E,
      (α : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ (β : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β : ℝ) * η ≤ 1) : Prop := by
  classical
  exact
    let c : E → E → E := fun y xRef => y - η • gradient V xRef
    let Φ : E → E → ℝ → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun y xRef t z =>
      (c y xRef + Real.cos t • (z.1 - c y xRef) +

Let E be any finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel space, including dimension zero. Let V:E→ℝ be C², α,β≥0 and η∈ℝ with α>0, α≤β, α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v∈E, η>0 and βη≤1. The following literal constructions are made for all y,r∈E and initial phases z₀∈E×E; the existential process witness below is global in these parameters. Put c=y−η∇V(r), Φ_t(x,p)=(c+cos(t)(x−c)+√η sin(t)p, −sin(t)(x−c)/√η+cos(t)p), g_r(x)=∇V(x)−∇V(r), S_r(x,p)=(x,p−2〈p,g_r(x)〉g_r(x)/‖g_r(x)‖²), λ_r(x,p)=√η max{0,〈p,g_r(x)〉}, Λ_z(t)=∫₀ᵗλ_r(Φ_s(z))ds and τ_z(e)=inf{t≥0:Λ_z(t)≥e}∈[0,∞], with inf empty=∞. Total real division makes S_r the identity at g_r(x)=0. The record space is D=([0,∞)×(E×E))⊕{stopped}, with Borel sum structure. Define next(e,stopped)=stopped; for a live record (T,z), next(e,(T,z))=stopped if τ_z(e)=∞, and otherwise next(e,(T,z))=(T+τ_z(e),S_rΦ_(τ_z(e))(z)). In the Lean definition untopD0 is used only in this non-top branch. Define R₀(e)=live(0,z₀) and R_(j+1)(e)=next(e_j,R_j(e)). Let Ω=ℝ^ℕ with its product Borel structure and P=⊗_(k≥0)Exp(1). Let ε(w)_k=max{w_k,0}; this is an ambient coordinate extension on a P-null nonpositive-clock set, not new source dynamics for negative clocks. 
Write T_j(w)=a for a live record R_j(ε(w))=live(a,z), and T_j(w)=∞ for a stopped record. Define I_n(T)={T_n≤T<T_(n+1)}, and the total selector N(T,w)=min{n:w∈I_n(T)} when such an n exists, and 0 otherwise. For n≥0 let Hist_n=D^(Fin(n+1)) and H_n(w)_j=R_j(ε(w)). The abstract guard A_n(T) consists of histories all of whose records are live, whose read times are strictly increasing and whose positive-index read times are strictly below T; it does not constrain record0 itself. Put R(x,p)=(x,-p), V_y(x)=V(x)+||x-y||^2/(2 eta), and nu_y=(volume_E.tilted(-V_y)) times stdGaussian(E), in position/momentum order. All these conclusions use the same Z, existentially chosen before all centers, references, horizons and observables. Products are phase first, clock input second. Dimension zero, T=0, vanishing test bounds, zero bounce rates, infinite waits and raw exceptional fallback remain included. For every Borel G:H->R, the total real clock expectation (y,r,z,T)->integral G(Z(y,r,z,T,w)) dP(w) is jointly Borel. If C is a finite nonnegative real number and |G(z)|<=C for all z, then for every y,r,z,T the clock section is P-integrable and the absolute value of this expectation is at most C.

The literal expectation op_T G belongs to L2(nu_y;R), and A_T[G]=[op_T G]. Thus integral |op_T G|^2 dnu_y <= integral |G|^2 dnu_y. Brackets denote equality classes modulo nu_y-almost-everywhere equality; no pointwise identification of arbitrary L2 representatives is asserted. The operator, section integrability and output L2 membership are conclusions, not supplied premises.
These operators use the same single global Z as all inherited path, initialization, invariance and bounded-duality conclusions. The bound1 is exact and independent of dimension, center, reference and horizon. The joint Borel assertion concerns Borel input G; arbitrary MemLp representatives receive the stated almost-everywhere conclusions.
